d:
The Thunder defeated the Cavaliers, 124-116 tonight in Oklahoma City. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander finished with a team-high 42 points along with 8 assists and 5 three pointers for the Thunder, while Ajay Mitchell tallied 23 points, 7 rebounds and 4 assists in the game. Donovan Mitchell recorded 27 points, 6 assists and 5 three pointers. The Thunder improve their record to 6-2 with the win, while the Cavaliers fall to 4-4 for the season.
